label: Which words of a screen are statements, not work: a busy button saying one of these ('I checked it', 'Yes, run it', 'OK') never titles the work window - it reads ww_busy_title instead
description_nl: Every word of the screen whose text the pattern finds: a sentence the person says ('I checked it'), a confirm ('Yes, ...'), a bare OK / Done / Right. Words that name work ('Import a deck', 'Save') are never in it.
weight_basis: Platform presentation primitive, no business content. The pattern IS the policy - edit it here, never in JavaScript.
